decision: The Source image uses the factory boot and system server class path order. Every factory boot JAR is on the Source BOOTCLASSPATH: telephony-ext and qcom.fmradio are built from their CodeLinaro LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900-sm8250.0 donors, the closed QTI and PICO/Smartisan JARs are the factory binaries (factory-framework/Android.bp, extracted by tools/install-device-tree.py) linked against the ported Smartisan framework layer. Every factory system server JAR is on the Source SYSTEMSERVERCLASSPATH in the factory order (sys-services, sysmonitor-services, vrex-services before services.jar): since Source 2.03 the services.jar Smartisan layer and the hook sites that sys-services and sysmonitor-services link against and call into are ported (outputs/audit/rebase-log.md, pass 4); the remaining link gaps are listed as accepted gaps.

product_configuration.device.mk: PRODUCT_BOOT_JARS_BEFORE_FRAMEWORK (sysmonitor-framework sys-framework devicemiddlewareimpl vrex-framework), PRODUCT_BOOT_JARS += tcmiface telephony-ext qcom.fmradio QPerformance UxPerformance WfdCommon, PRODUCT_SYSTEM_SERVER_JARS_BEFORE_SERVICES sys-services sysmonitor-services vrex-services, PRODUCT_PACKAGES for all of them
product_configuration.build/make: PRODUCT_BOOT_JARS_BEFORE_FRAMEWORK/PRODUCT_SYSTEM_SERVER_JARS_BEFORE_SERVICES product variables and check_boot_jars package whitelist entries
product_configuration.hiddenapi: factory binaries keep the hidden-API flags encoded in their factory DEX (dex_import does not re-encode); CodeLinaro builds are encoded by the Source hiddenapi rule and compared with the factory flags
product_configuration.dexpreopt: factory oat/vdex are not used; the boot JARs are compiled into the Source boot image and the system server JARs are dexpreopted against it

sysmonitor-framework.provenance: PICO/Smartisan proprietary (android.casthal, IDataReport*, AnrLogger, SysMonitorFwFactoryImpl, BatteryStatsImplOptEx, smartisanos.util); no source donor
sysmonitor-framework.entry_points: framework SysMonitorFwBridge loads android.app.SysMonitorFwFactoryImpl; sys-framework SysFwFactoryImpl extends it

sys-framework.provenance: PICO/Smartisan proprietary (SysFwFactoryImpl, ArtTracerUtils, MemClient, BootReceiverPhone); no source donor

devicemiddlewareimpl.provenance: PICO proprietary (picodevice.*: DeviceContext, ScheduleExt, SysDataSyncExt); no source donor
devicemiddlewareimpl.entry_points: none found statically in factory framework, services or apps (public picodevice API)

vrex-framework.provenance: PICO proprietary test extension (android.os.Apitest1Impl implements framework IApitest1); no source donor

tcmiface.provenance: QTI closed (DPM TCM interface com.quicinc.tcmiface.DpmTcmIface); not in CodeLinaro LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900 (platform/vendor/qcom-opensource/dpm has no tcmiface)
tcmiface.entry_points: used by factory tcmclient.jar (DPM client, not on the Source class path)

telephony-ext.provenance: QTI open: CodeLinaro platform/vendor/codeaurora/telephony internal/ (27d0001003086c8e8889b69fbfa260bb7804740e), Source component vendor/codeaurora/telephony
telephony-ext.entry_points: no extphone server on the factory; IExtTelephony$Stub.asInterface(ServiceManager.getService("extphone")) returns null

qcom.fmradio.provenance: QTI open: CodeLinaro platform/vendor/qcom-opensource/fm-commonsys (0d397db45c79034fdefc1c78e2fd8fee6c724368), Source component vendor/qcom/opensource/fm-commonsys
qcom.fmradio.entry_points: no factory consumer; FmReceiverJNI loads libqcomfm_jni only when an FM API is used (the headset has no FM receiver; BOARD_HAVE_QCOM_FM is not set, the JNI/HAL libraries are not built)

QPerformance.provenance: QTI closed perf (com.qualcomm.qti.Performance, IPerfManager; server /system/bin/perfservice vendor.perfservice); not in CodeLinaro
QPerformance.entry_points: framework android.util.BoostFramework loads com.qualcomm.qti.Performance by reflection

UxPerformance.provenance: QTI closed perf (com.qualcomm.qti.UxPerformance); not in CodeLinaro
UxPerformance.entry_points: framework android.util.BoostFramework loads com.qualcomm.qti.UxPerformance by reflection

WfdCommon.provenance: QTI closed WFD (com.qualcomm.wfd.*); CodeLinaro wfd-commonsys LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900 only has libaac
WfdCommon.entry_points: factory services ExtendedRemoteDisplayHelper loads com.qualcomm.wfd.ExtendedRemoteDisplay (CodeLinaro frameworks/base display path, not yet in Source services); factory WfdService.apk

sys-services.provenance: PICO/Smartisan proprietary system_server optimisations (SysSvsFactoryImpl extends sysmonitor-services SysMonitorSvcFactoryImpl: ApplicationFreezer, FreezeController, PrefetchManagerService, MemoryReclaimer, MemoryProcessController, SmartService, SmartScenes, SmartisanPowerAdvisor, QuickBootStateMachine, SysTransServer ...); no source donor
sys-services.entry_points: services.jar SysOptBridge loads com.android.server.am.SysSvsFactoryImpl; hook sites in AMS/ProcessList/OomAdjuster/ActiveServices/BroadcastQueue/ActivityStack/PowerManagerService/SystemServer ...

sysmonitor-services.provenance: PICO/Smartisan/ByteDance proprietary monitoring (com.smartisan.monitor, TransferServer "transferserver", AnrMonitor, jank, slardaros client, SysMonitorSvcFactoryImpl); no source donor
sysmonitor-services.entry_points: services.jar SysMonitorSvcBridge loads com.android.server.am.SysMonitorSvcFactoryImpl (also the superclass of sys-services SysSvsFactoryImpl); ActivityManagerServiceSmtBase.setSystemProcess publishes its TransferServer

vrex-services.provenance: PICO proprietary test extension (com.android.server.Apitest2Impl implements services IApitest2); no source donor
